narrative.intro: UT-Battelle has $2.6B in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. The company won 1 award this fiscal year, producing an average award size of $2.6B. Obligations fell down 3.7% year over year compared with the prior fiscal period. Historical obligations show a pattern of large, stable annual funding: FY21 was $2.3B, FY22 was $2.5B, FY23 was $2.7B, FY24 was $2.5B, and FY25 was $2.7B. The FY26 total of $2.6B fits within that range. The award-count and average-award figures point to a small number of high-dollar contracts rather than many smaller purchases. Use these facts when planning capture and proposal efforts that target big, single-award opportunities or prime-level relationships with national laboratories and research-focused agencies. Contracting officers and program managers evaluating UT-Battelle should expect obligations at the prime level to concentrate into a few large awards rather than a broad portfolio of small orders.
